findings.finding: The shock and directional-persistence conditions use only the current completed bar and prior closes. They are causal if evaluated after the current bar closes.
findings.required_execution: Enter only at the first executable quote after the signal bar close.

findings.finding: The public ATR is computed on a rolling true-range mean that includes the current shock bar. This is causal at bar close but changes the meaning of shock relative to using only pre-shock volatility.
findings.required_action: Preregister both CURRENT_INCLUDED and LAGGED_PRE_SHOCK ATR normalization as distinct causal interpretations before mining.

findings.finding: np.roll for c1/c2/c3 wraps terminal observations into the first three rows.
findings.required_action: Invalidate the first three observations of every series using three lags.

findings.finding: The public simulator enters at signal-bar close and does not implement QROS Bid/Ask execution.
findings.required_action: Do not import public PnL. Reimplement QROS execution with BUY Ask/Bid and SELL Bid/Ask, SL-first ambiguity, first available gap fill and same-day exit.
